text: Seed 23's N=128 force R2 rises with width from 0.696 (d64, layer 1) to 0.765 (d128, layer 3) to 0.788 (d256, layer 1). Read at fixed layer 1 across d_model 64/128/256, does N=128 force gain about 0.02-0.03 per doubling while N=64 layer-1 force stays flat? If so, the layer-1 gap would shrink geometrically and the best-layer gap would stay near 0.05.
